add.title: LGBTQ rights in Nigeria (Wikipedia)
add.summary: The only Bauchi-specific detention data found in the mandated Wikipedia full-text search plus candidate fetches: the article records that eighteen men were arrested by Bauchi state police and charged with sodomy for dressing as women (illegal under the Shari'a penal code); the charges were later dropped to vagrancy, and the men were held in jail for several years awaiting trial, a pre-trial detention that dissolved by the end of 2011. This documents that persons perceived as trans-feminine in Bauchi have been arrested and held in custody under Shari'a charges for years, but the article contains no information on where such detainees are housed inside custody (male-vs-female wing, special unit, or solitary/segregation), and no trans-specific placement rule, facility or policy is documented for Bauchi.
